title: RoSe-SLAM: Robust Semantic-Aware Gaussian Splatting SLAM from Dynamic Monocular Videos
abstract: arXiv:2608.29003v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In dynamic and unstructured environments, conventional SLAM systems generally suffer from significant accuracy degeneration due to their static assumptions. In this work, we propose Robust Semantic-aware Gaussian Splatting SLAM (RoSe-SLAM), to address the dynamic challenge by a holistic semantic scene understanding from uncalibrated monocular inputs, achieving accurate camera tracking and high-quality geometry reconstruction. Unlike conventional semantic SLAM using handcrafted semantic labels, our RoSe-SLAM exploits the semantic feature from 2D foundation model to enhance the dynamic tracking and mapping performance. By distilling the rich semantic features to our Gaussian fields, our method effectively identifies dynamic distractors and achieves semantic-aware multi-view consistency, significantly enhancing the geometric reconstruction and scene inpainting. translated_title: RoSe-SLAM：面向动态单目视频的鲁棒语义感知高斯泼溅SLAM
translated_abstract: 在动态和非结构化环境中，传统SLAM系统由于其静态假设，通常会出现显著的精度下降。在本工作中，我们提出了鲁棒语义感知高斯泼溅SLAM（RoSe-SLAM），通过从未标定的单目输入中进行整体语义场景理解来应对动态挑战，实现精确的相机跟踪和高质量的几何重建。与使用手工语义标签的传统语义SLAM不同，我们的RoSe-SLAM利用二维基础模型的语义特征来增强动态跟踪与建图性能。通过将丰富的语义特征蒸馏到我们的高斯场中，我们的方法能够有效识别动态干扰物，并实现语义感知的多视角一致性，显著提升了几何重建和场景修复的效果。具体而言，我们提出了一个时空运动掩码生成模块……
tldr: 提出RoSe-SLAM，通过利用二维基础模型蒸馏的语义特征和时空运动掩码生成模块，实现从动态单目视频中精确相机跟踪与高质量几何重建的鲁棒语义感知高斯泼溅SLAM系统。
en_tdlr: RoSe-SLAM achieves robust semantic-aware Gaussian Splatting SLAM by leveraging semantic features distilled from 2D foundation models and a spatial-temporal motion mask generation module, enabling accurate camera tracking and high-quality geometry reconstruction from dynamic monocular videos.
